LanguageData.ABY_CraftAbyssalGravplatePrototype.label: forge dominion gravplate shell
LanguageData.ABY_CraftAbyssalGravplatePrototype.descr: Bind crowned-core pressure, dominion crown shards and a dense grav-suspension lattice into a human-scale survival shell. The result is not a heavier carapace; it is a breach frame for fighters expected to cross hostile ground under fire.
LanguageData.ABY_CraftAbyssalGravplateHelmPrototype.d: Set a dominion crown shard into a sealed command helm tuned for gravplate vector control. The optics are built to read breach angles and kill-zone pressure rather than simply brighten the wearer's sight.
